D1-M07: In Round 2 the Pack charged six times: all three Muqatila squads fell back and all three failed the test, and the Weretiger Stalkers' kill of Muqatila Troopers 1 and the Rammal Geomancer paid ASSASSINATION and DEBT OF BLOOD in a 10 VP round. Saladin took the centre back in Round 4, but Sword of Allah completed no secondary to the Pack's 9 VP of them.
D1-M08: The Bailiffs planted RAISE THE STANDARD in the enemy half, scored its full 10 by Round 4 and led 27-23 after Round 5. Then their Cultist holders failed Morale every round - SUPPRESSED at OC 0, they fed COORDINATED SUPPRESSION - and Legio XIII's last round hit the 10 VP cap while the Bailiffs scored nothing.
D1-M09: The Host's ten units scored IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS to its 10 VP limit and held two objectives in Rounds 3 and 4, and the Blackflint Archers shot down the Parish Militia and the Knight-Ascendants. The Knights' GARRISON DUTY, worth 4 VP to them the first time, scored 0: every Knights unit on an objective moved, attacked or counterattacked every round. The first playing went the other way, 30-10.
D1-M10: The Rade held all three objectives in Rounds 1 and 2 and led 19-2. The Vigil came back with a capped 10 VP Round 4 that killed four Rade units, and the Redcap Reivers' kill on the centre in Round 6 completed KING OF THE HILL and ended it.
D1-M11: The Sineaters charged Etxe Riflemen 3 off the centre in Round 2 and destroyed it, and from Round 3 they held all three objectives. The Oak destroyed no enemy unit all battle (0 RP to 113), so ERADICATE THE FOE never paid, and it scored nothing after Round 2.
D1-M12: It stood 15-17 after Round 3. Then the Knights of Tehom took the centre, the Evil-Eye Serpent killed the Judgement's HQ and its last holders, and three requisitioned Cultist squads kept the flanks. The Judgement destroyed two Cultist squads (20 RP to 134) and completed no secondary. The first playing went the other way, 31-22.
